# VOA Learning English

> > Learn American English through news, daily video briefings, and educational content from Voice of America

VOA Learning English provides English language learners with accessible news content, including daily video briefings (VOA60 series) covering world events, African affairs, and US news. The site combines language education with current events reporting on topics ranging from international politics to culture and agriculture.

## Key Topics

- Voice of America (VOA)
- English language learning
- VOA60 video news series
- International news coverage
- African news and politics
- US current events
- Egypt and Middle East affairs
- Kenya and East Africa
- Afghanistan and South Asia
- Muslim Brotherhood
- Sudan and South Sudan conflict
- Somalia and regional security
- Daily news briefings
- Video-based learning content
- American culture and society

## Home

- [Voice of America - Learn American English with VOA Learning English](https://learningenglish.voanews.com): VOA Learning English homepage: American English lessons & daily news
